bandReport.notes: Final band. p12 (not mine) ends cleanly with Q80 fully printed in its right column, so nothing straddles the p12/p13 seam and Q81 opens my band clean. p16 is the last page of the booklet and the paper genuinely ends at Q100 (right column ends with Q100 option (d) 2004; no further page exists). The Directions block for the last four items STARTS on p16 in my band (left column, below Q96), so I own Q97-100 and have carried its table verbatim into context on all four. No answer key appears anywhere on p13-p16. No printed figure/diagram appears anywhere on p13-p16 — the geometry items in this band (Q81-Q90) are all stated fully in words, so no row sets hasFigure. Q91 and Q92 each carry their OWN table and are standalone items, NOT a Directions set — their tables are therefore in stem, not context. Ranges printed with an en dash (e.g. marks '1-10', years '2000-2005') are transcribed with an ASCII hyphen; the printed minus in Q93's data (-1) is likewise an ASCII hyphen-minus so it cannot be read as a dash. Q92's frequencies sum to 90, matching the stem's stated 90 students. NEIGHBOUR TERRITORY — a 13-question gap was observed mid-run and has since CLOSED, recorded because the gate could not see it: at the time I finished transcribing, Q21-27 (fully printed on p04, band b1's own last page) and Q75-80 (fully printed on p12, band b3's own last page) appeared in no band file at all, leaving the paper at 87 of 100. b1 and b3 have since extended to 1-27 and 54-80 respectively and a re-check now reads 100/100 with no gaps and no duplicates, so nothing is outstanding. Worth keeping because check-bands.ts is structurally blind to this class: it validates each band against its OWN bandReport, and both b1 and b3 were internally self-consistent throughout, so only a paper-wide 1..N coverage check catches a run stranded at a band's trailing page.

questions.stem: The sides of a right-angled triangle are in the ratio \(x : (x - 1) : (x - 18)\). What is the perimeter of the triangle?

\(ABC\) is a triangle right angled at \(B\). Let \(M\) and \(N\) be two points on \(AB\) such that \(AM = MN = NB\). Let \(P\) and \(Q\) be two points on \(AC\) such that \(PM\) is parallel to \(QN\) and \(QN\) is parallel to \(CB\). If \(BC = 12\) cm, then what is \((PM + QN)\) equal to?
\(AB\) and \(CD\) are the diameters of a circle which intersect at \(P\). Join \(AC\), \(CB\), \(BD\) and \(DA\). If \(\angle PAD = 60^\circ\), then what is \(\angle BPD\) equal to?
An equilateral triangle \(ABC\) and a scalene triangle \(DBC\) are inscribed in a circle on same side of the arc. What is \(\angle BDC\) equal to?

The sides of a triangle \(ABC\) are 4 cm, 6 cm and 8 cm. With the vertices of the triangle as centres, three circles are drawn each touching the other two externally. What is the sum of the radii of the three circles?
Let \(PAB\) be a secant to a circle intersecting the circle at \(A\) and \(B\). Let \(PT\) be the tangent segment. If \(PA = 9\) cm and \(PT = 12\) cm, then what is \(AB\) equal to?
If the perimeter of a right-angled triangle is 30 cm and the hypotenuse is 13 cm, then what is the area of the triangle?
\(ABC\) is a triangle right angled at \(C\). Let \(p\) be the length of the perpendicular drawn from \(C\) on \(AB\). If \(BC = 6\) cm and \(CA = 8\) cm, then what is the value of \(p\)?

questions.stem: \(ABCD\) is a trapezium in which \(AB\) is parallel to \(DC\) and \(2AB = 3DC\). The diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) intersect at \(O\). What is the ratio of the area of \(\triangle AOB\) to that of \(\triangle DOC\)?
A circle touches all the four sides of a quadrilateral \(ABCD\). If \(AB = 9\) cm, \(BC = 8\) cm and \(CD = 12\) cm, then what is \(DA\) equal to?

Consider the following data with regard to production of cars (in lakhs) :

|  | Year 2015 | Year 2016 |
|---|---|---|
| Country \(A\) | 35 | 38 |
| Country \(B\) | 45 | 47 |
| Country \(C\) | 88 | 93 |
| Country \(D\) | 75 | 79 |
| Country \(E\) | 58 | 60.9 |

In which of the countries, the production of cars has increased by more than or equal to 5% in 2016 over 2015?

The following table shows the marks of 90 students in a test of 80 marks :

| Marks | Number of students |
|---|---|
| 1-10 | 5 |
| 11-20 | 8 |
| 21-30 | 10 |
| 31-40 | 13 |
| 41-50 | 18 |
| 51-60 | 17 |
| 61-70 | 12 |
| 71-80 | 7 |

The percentage of students who have obtained less than or equal to 50% marks is

What is the median of the following data?

2, 3, -1, 2, 6, 8, 9
What is the arithmetic mean of the first ten composite numbers?
The marks obtained by 5 students are 21, 27, 19, 26, 32. Later on 5 grace marks are added to each student. What are the average marks of the revised marks of the students?

Let \(p\) be the mean of \(m\) observations and \(q\) be the mean of \(n\) observations, where \(p \le q\). If the combined mean of \((m + n)\) observations is \(c\), then which one of the following is correct?
